# FLX-3625: a consumer query or view names a table that resolves to more than one

**Family:** seam/conformance (the 3000 band)

Unquoted names compare without regard to case and quoted names exactly. A name that matches two exposes, an expose and a WITH name or view that shadows it, or an expose that differs from another only in case (DuckDB cannot tell two such tables apart), is refused rather than guessed. Quote the name, rename the WITH entry, or map the table in tables.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-3625
```
